text: Do the kumkuma puja while reciting the ashtottara shatanamavali of Sri Mahalakshmi.
If you have an idol, offer a little kumkuma on the idol with each name you recite.
If you have a picture of Ammavaru, place a small bowl in front of it and offer the kumkuma into it.
When all 108 names are done, offer your namaskaram to Ammavaru.
